description.p: LangSpark is a native, offline-first Japanese vocabulary application combining spaced repetition (SM-2 or FSRS) with pronunciation practice: play a reference pronunciation via VOICEVOX, record yourself, and get scored against a speech-recognition transcript with a per-character breakdown of what was and wasn't heard. Dictionary data (JMdict, Kanjidic) and supplemental example sentences (Tatoeba) install from within the app.
